notes.title: Full graphics upgrade plus new content
notes.content:
Starfighter Arduxim has undergone a major upgrade. The main improvements are:
[list]
[*]     New missions have been added to the campaign.
[*]     Complete graphical overhaul. All ship models and weapon effects have been upgraded.
[*]     Added a new primary weapon: the kinetic lance which allows for long range precision shooting.
[*]     Add a new secondary weapon: drop mines behind your ship to surprise the enemy you can’t shake off.
[*]     A pre-mission briefing similar to those of the original Wing Commander.
[*]     Added a cruise mode that greatly increases the ship’s speed at the cost of being unable to turn or fire.
[*]     Voice chat support added to multiplayer.
[/list]
